selectRunHint: Select a run on the left → timeline · time-travel · trace · forks.
otelExportButtonTitle: Export this run's trace to your APM (OTEL)
forkFromStepTitle: Fork a new run from this step
step0Empty: Step 0 — no messages yet. Press Play to watch the conversation build.
noSpansEmpty: No spans for this run (requires journal ts records).
noForksPart1: This run has no forks. Rewind to a step in the time-travel tab and use
noForksPart2: to create a "what-if" branch — the journal prefix is copied, and the branch continues live from that step.
firstDivergentLineDiff: line diff of first diverging message (A → B)
allDecisionsSame: ✓ All decision points are identical — no divergence (deterministic replay).
noDecisionPointsEmpty: No decision points (no model/tool step found).
noProcessorRecordsEmpty: No processor records for this run.
conflictError: This approval was already decided elsewhere: {{error}}
noRunsEmptyDescription: Runs appear here as soon as an agent executes. Start one in the Playground.
purgeDialogDescription: ALL records in the journal (including model/tool/memory traces) will be permanently deleted; 'run.purge' is recorded in the audit log. This cannot be undone.
networkNotUsedEmpty: This run didn't use the dynamic agent network (router → agent) — routes/steps are empty.
noIncidentsEmpty: No guard incidents for this run.
unwindButtonTitle: Unwind (saga): undo this run’s executed side effects in reverse order — IRREVERSIBLE, the run can never resume
unwindDialogDescription: Every executed side effect whose tool declares a compensate hook will be undone in REVERSE order (refund, release…). The run is CONDEMNED first: it can never run or resume again. This cannot be undone.
cancelRunButtonTitle: Cancel (durable) — stops at this run's next step, on any worker; a canceled run can never resume again
cancelRunDialogDescription: Studio has no in-process abort here — this writes a cross-worker flag instead: the run stops at its NEXT fresh model step, wherever it's running, and every future resume attempt is refused (terminal, like Unwind). This cannot be undone.
cancelRunDoneToast: '{{runId}}' canceled — stops at its next step
threadNoTurns: No completed turns in this thread yet.
memNoProvenance: No memory provenance recorded for this turn (run predates provenance, or memory was off).
memObservations: {{count}} condensed observations injected as system context
memObservations_one: {{count}} condensed observation injected as system context
memIncomingUnrecoverable: The input processors left no recoverable copy of this turn, so the thread holds this answer with no question. The pre-processor messages were deliberately not used as a fallback — they are unmasked. Reason:

memLossReason.messages-dropped: The processor chain returned no `messages` array at all (flattened into a prompt, or a partial input).
memLossReason.boundary-lost: The chain rebuilt every message, so nothing anchored the history/incoming split any more.
memLossReason.turn-dropped: The split was known and the chain removed this turn from it (a trim that could not protect it).

memDedupedByShape: deduplicated on the masked shapes — the turn count may be short by one if two different raw inputs redact to the same text
memLayoutLine: memory gave {{gave}} · {{sent}} sent to the model
memLayoutDropped: {{count}} removed by an input processor before the model saw them
memLayoutDropped_one: {{count}} removed by an input processor before the model saw it
memLayoutForeign: {{count}} added by an input processor (not memory's)
memLayoutForeign_one: {{count}} added by an input processor (not memory's)
memLayoutRewritten: {{count}} of memory's rewritten in place by an input processor
memLayoutRewritten_one: {{count}} of memory's rewritten in place by an input processor
memLayoutAmbiguous: {{count}} of memory's content whose part cannot be told
memLayoutAmbiguous_one: {{count}} of memory's content whose part cannot be told
memLayoutUndiagnosable: The layout says “{{status}}” — this turn cannot be diagnosed by position.
memNoLayout: No layout recorded — this turn cannot be diagnosed by position. The counts below are memory's own report, taken before the input processors ran. Reason:
memUnreadable: This memory record is not one this version can read — nothing in it is shown.
ghostTurnTitle: This question's run died before its first token — the write-ahead kept the message, but no run exists for it.
labButtonTitle: Open this run in the Lab: see why, change a copy and try it — nothing runs and nothing is written
memLayoutUnresolved: A layout was recorded but could not be aligned (the history was too large to match row by row) — this turn cannot be diagnosed by position.
threadLabButtonTitle: Open this thread in the Lab: its turns above, the failed one chosen — the thread and its memory are only read
